translations.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
translations.ylt: Paul, an apostle--not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who did raise him out of the dead--
translations.web: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

translations.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
translations.ylt: and all the brethren with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
translations.web: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

translations.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
translations.ylt: Grace to you, and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
translations.web: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
translations.ylt: who did give himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of the present evil age, according to the will of God even our Father,
translations.web: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

translations.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: to whom is the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.
translations.web: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

translations.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
translations.ylt: I wonder that ye are so quickly removed from Him who did call you in the grace of Christ to another good news;
translations.web: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

translations.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
translations.ylt: that is not another, except there be certain who are troubling you, and wishing to pervert the good news of the Christ;
translations.web: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

translations.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
translations.ylt: but even if we or a messenger out of heaven may proclaim good news to you different from what we did proclaim to you--anathema let him be!
translations.web: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

translations.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
translations.ylt: as we have said before, and now say again, If any one to you may proclaim good news different from what ye did receive--anathema let him be!
translations.web: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

translations.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
translations.ylt: for now men do I persuade, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if yet men I did please--Christ's servant I should not be.
translations.web: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

translations.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
translations.ylt: And I make known to you, brethren, the good news that were proclaimed by me, that it is not according to man,
translations.web: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

translations.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: for neither did I from man receive it, nor was I taught it, but through a revelation of Jesus Christ,
translations.web: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
translations.ylt: for ye did hear of my behaviour once in Judaism, that exceedingly I was persecuting the assembly of God, and wasting it,
translations.web: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

translations.kjv: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
translations.ylt: and I was advancing in Judaism above many equals in age in mine own race, being more abundantly zealous of my fathers' deliverances,
translations.web: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

translations.kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,
translations.ylt: and when God was well pleased--having separated me from the womb of my mother, and having called me through His grace--
translations.web: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

translations.kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
translations.ylt: to reveal His Son in me, that I might proclaim him good news among the nations, immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood,
translations.web: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

translations.kjv: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
translations.ylt: nor did I go up to Jerusalem unto those who were apostles before me, but I went away to Arabia, and again returned to Damascus,
translations.web: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

translations.kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
translations.ylt: then, after three years I went up to Jerusalem to enquire about Peter, and remained with him fifteen days,
translations.web: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

translations.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.
translations.ylt: and other of the apostles I did not see, except James, the brother of the Lord.
translations.web: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

translations.kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
translations.ylt: And the things that I write to you, lo, before God--I lie not;
translations.web: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

translations.kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
translations.ylt: then I came to the regions of Syria and of Cilicia,
translations.web: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

translations.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judea which were in Christ:
translations.ylt: and was unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea, that are in Christ,
translations.web: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

translations.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
translations.ylt: and only they were hearing, that `he who is persecuting us then, doth now proclaim good news--the faith that then he was wasting;'
translations.web: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

translations.kjv: And they glorified God in me.
translations.ylt: and they were glorifying God in me.
translations.web: So they glorified God in me.

translations.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
translations.ylt: Then, after fourteen years again I went up to Jerusalem with Barnabas, having taken with me also Titus;
translations.web: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

translations.kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
translations.ylt: and I went up by revelation, and did submit to them the good news that I preach among the nations, and privately to those esteemed, lest in vain I might run or did run;
translations.web: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

translations.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
translations.ylt: but not even Titus, who is with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised--
translations.web: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

translations.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
translations.ylt: and that because of the false brethren brought in unawares, who did come in privily to spy out our liberty that we have in Christ Jesus, that us they might bring under bondage,
translations.web: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

translations.kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
translations.ylt: to whom not even for an hour we gave place by subjection, that the truth of the good news might remain to you.
translations.web: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

translations.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
translations.ylt: And from those who were esteemed to be something--whatever they were then, it maketh no difference to me--the face of man God accepteth not, for--to me those esteemed did add nothing,
translations.web: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

translations.kjv: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
translations.ylt: but, on the contrary, having seen that I have been entrusted with the good news of the uncircumcision, as Peter with that of the circumcision,
translations.web: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

translations.kjv: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
translations.ylt: for He who did work with Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, did work also in me in regard to the nations,
translations.web: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

translations.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
translations.ylt: and having known the grace that was given to me, James, and Cephas, and John, who were esteemed to be pillars, a right hand of fellowship they did give to me, and to Barnabas, that we to the nations, and they to the circumcision may go,
translations.web: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

translations.kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
translations.ylt: only, of the poor that we should be mindful, which also I was diligent--this very thing--to do.
translations.web: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

translations.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
translations.ylt: And when Peter came to Antioch, to the face I stood up against him, because he was blameworthy,
translations.web: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

translations.kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
translations.ylt: for before the coming of certain from James, with the nations he was eating, and when they came, he was withdrawing and separating himself, fearing those of the circumcision,
translations.web: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

translations.kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
translations.ylt: and dissemble with him also did the other Jews, so that also Barnabas was carried away by their dissimulation.
translations.web: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

translations.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
translations.ylt: But when I saw that they are not walking uprightly to the truth of the good news, I said to Peter before all, `If thou, being a Jew, in the manner of the nations dost live, and not in the manner of the Jews, how the nations dost thou compel to Judaize?
translations.web: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

translations.kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
translations.ylt: we by nature Jews, and not sinners of the nations,
translations.web: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

translations.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
translations.ylt: having known also that a man is not declared righteous by works of law, if not through the faith of Jesus Christ, also we in Christ Jesus did believe, that we might be declared righteous by the faith of Christ, and not by works of law, wherefore declared righteous by works of law shall be no flesh.'
translations.web: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

translations.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
translations.ylt: And if, seeking to be declared righteous in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is then Christ a ministrant of sin? let it not be!
translations.web: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

translations.kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
translations.ylt: for if the things I threw down, these again I build up, a transgressor I set myself forth;
translations.web: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

translations.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
translations.ylt: for I through law, did die, that to God I may live;
translations.web: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

translations.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
translations.ylt: with Christ I have been crucified, and live no more do I, and Christ doth live in me; and that which I now live in the flesh--in the faith I live of the Son of God, who did love me and did give himself for me;
translations.web: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

translations.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
translations.ylt: I do not make void the grace of God, for if righteousness be through law--then Christ died in vain.
translations.web: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

translations.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
translations.ylt: O thoughtless Galatians, who did bewitch you, not to obey the truth--before whose eyes Jesus Christ was described before among you crucified?
translations.web: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

translations.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
translations.ylt: this only do I wish to learn from you--by works of law the Spirit did ye receive, or by the hearing of faith?
translations.web: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

translations.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
translations.ylt: so thoughtless are ye! having begun in the Spirit, now in the flesh do ye end?
translations.web: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

translations.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
translations.ylt: so many things did ye suffer in vain! if, indeed, even in vain.
translations.web: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

translations.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
translations.ylt: He, therefore, who is supplying to you the Spirit, and working mighty acts among you--by works of law or by the hearing of faith is it?
translations.web: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

translations.kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
translations.ylt: according as Abraham did believe God, and it was reckoned to him--to righteousness;
translations.web: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

translations.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
translations.ylt: know ye, then, that those of faith--these are sons of Abraham,
translations.web: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

translations.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
translations.ylt: and the Writing having foreseen that by faith God doth declare righteous the nations did proclaim before the good news to Abraham--
translations.web: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

translations.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
translations.ylt: `Blessed in thee shall be all the nations;' so that those of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham,
translations.web: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

translations.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
translations.ylt: for as many as are of works of law are under a curse, for it hath been written, `Cursed is every one who is not remaining in all things that have been written in the Book of the Law--to do them,'
translations.web: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

translations.kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
translations.ylt: and that in law no one is declared righteous with God, is evident, because `The righteous by faith shall live;'
translations.web: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

translations.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
translations.ylt: and the law is not by faith, but--`The man who did them shall live in them.'
translations.web: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

translations.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
translations.ylt: Christ did redeem us from the curse of the law, having become for us a curse, for it hath been written, `Cursed is every one who is hanging on a tree,'
translations.web: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

translations.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
translations.ylt: that to the nations the blessing of Abraham may come in Christ Jesus, that the promise of the Spirit we may receive through the faith.
translations.web: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

translations.kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
translations.ylt: Brethren, as a man I say it, even of man a confirmed covenant no one doth make void or doth add to,
translations.web: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

translations.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
translations.ylt: and to Abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed; He doth not say, `And to seeds,' as of many, but as of one, `And to thy seed,' which is Christ;
translations.web: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

translations.kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
translations.ylt: and this I say, A covenant confirmed before by God to Christ, the law, that came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not set aside, to make void the promise,
translations.web: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

translations.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
translations.ylt: for if by law be the inheritance, it is no more by promise, but to Abraham through promise did God grant it.
translations.web: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

translations.kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
translations.ylt: Why, then, the law? on account of the transgressions it was added, till the seed might come to which the promise hath been made, having been set in order through messengers in the hand of a mediator--
translations.web: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

translations.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
translations.ylt: and the mediator is not of one, and God is one--
translations.web: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

translations.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
translations.ylt: the law, then, is against the promises of God? --let it not be! for if a law was given that was able to make alive, truly by law there would have been the righteousness,
translations.web: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

translations.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
translations.ylt: but the Writing did shut up the whole under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ may be given to those believing.
translations.web: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

translations.kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
translations.ylt: And before the coming of the faith, under law we were being kept, shut up to the faith about to be revealed,
translations.web: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

translations.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
translations.ylt: so that the law became our child-conductor--to Christ, that by faith we may be declared righteous,
translations.web: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

translations.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
translations.ylt: and the faith having come, no more under a child-conductor are we,
translations.web: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

translations.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: for ye are all sons of God through the faith in Christ Jesus,
translations.web: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
translations.ylt: for as many as to Christ were baptized did put on Christ;
translations.web: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

translations.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: there is not here Jew or Greek, there is not here servant nor freeman, there is not here male and female, for all ye are one in Christ Jesus;
translations.web: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
translations.ylt: and if ye are of Christ then of Abraham ye are seed, and according to promise--heirs.
translations.web: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

translations.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
translations.ylt: And I say, so long time as the heir is a babe, he differeth nothing from a servant--being lord of all,
translations.web: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

translations.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
translations.ylt: but is under tutors and stewards till the time appointed of the father,
translations.web: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

translations.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
translations.ylt: so also we, when we were babes, under the elements of the world were in servitude,
translations.web: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

translations.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
translations.ylt: and when the fulness of time did come, God sent forth His Son, come of a woman, come under law,
translations.web: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

translations.kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
translations.ylt: that those under law he may redeem, that the adoption of sons we may receive;
translations.web: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

translations.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
translations.ylt: and because ye are sons, God did send forth the spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying, `Abba, Father!'
translations.web: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

translations.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
translations.ylt: so that thou art no more a servant, but a son, and if a son, also an heir of God through Christ.
translations.web: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

translations.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
translations.ylt: But then, indeed, not having known God, ye were in servitude to those not by nature gods,
translations.web: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

translations.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
translations.ylt: and now, having known God--and rather being known by God--how turn ye again unto the weak and poor elements to which anew ye desire to be in servitude?
translations.web: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

translations.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
translations.ylt: days ye observe, and months, and times, and years!
translations.web: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

translations.kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
translations.ylt: I am afraid of you, lest in vain I did labour toward you.
translations.web: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

translations.kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
translations.ylt: Become as I am --because I also am as ye brethren, I beseech you; to me ye did no hurt,
translations.web: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

translations.kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
translations.ylt: and ye have known that through infirmity of the flesh I did proclaim good news to you at the first,
translations.web: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

translations.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: and my trial that is in my flesh ye did not despise nor reject, but as a messenger of God ye did receive me--as Christ Jesus;
translations.web: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
translations.ylt: what then was your happiness? for I testify to you, that if possible, your eyes having plucked out, ye would have given to me;
translations.web: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

translations.kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
translations.ylt: so that your enemy have I become, being true to you?
translations.web: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

translations.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
translations.ylt: they are zealous for you-- yet not well, but they wish to shut us out, that for them ye may be zealous;
translations.web: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

translations.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
translations.ylt: and it is good to be zealously regarded, in what is good, at all times, and not only in my being present with you;
translations.web: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

translations.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
translations.ylt: my little children, of whom again I travail in birth, till Christ may be formed in you,
translations.web: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

translations.kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
translations.ylt: and I was wishing to be present with you now, and to change my voice, because I am in doubt about you.
translations.web: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

translations.kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
translations.ylt: Tell me, ye who are willing to be under law, the law do ye not hear?
translations.web: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

translations.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
translations.ylt: for it hath been written, that Abraham had two sons, one by the maid-servant, and one by the free-woman,
translations.web: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

translations.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
translations.ylt: but he who is of the maid-servant, according to flesh hath been, and he who is of the free-woman, through the promise;
translations.web: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

translations.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
translations.ylt: which things are allegorized, for these are the two covenants: one, indeed, from mount Sinai, to servitude bringing forth, which is Hagar;
translations.web: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

translations.kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
translations.ylt: for this Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and doth correspond to the Jerusalem that now is, and is in servitude with her children,
translations.web: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

translations.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
translations.ylt: and the Jerusalem above is the free-woman, which is mother of us all,
translations.web: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

translations.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
translations.ylt: for it hath been written, `Rejoice, O barren, who art not bearing; break forth and cry, thou who art not travailing, because many are the children of the desolate--more than of her having the husband.'
translations.web: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

translations.kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
translations.ylt: And we, brethren, as Isaac, are children of promise,
translations.web: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

translations.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
translations.ylt: but as then he who was born according to the flesh did persecute him according to the spirit, so also now;
translations.web: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
translations.ylt: but what saith the Writing? `Cast forth the maid-servant and her son, for the son of the maid-servant may not be heir with the son of the free-woman;'
translations.web: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

translations.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
translations.ylt: then, brethren, we are not a maid-servant's children, but the free-woman's.
translations.web: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

translations.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
translations.ylt: In the freedom, then, with which Christ did make you free--stand ye, and be not held fast again by a yoke of servitude;
translations.web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

translations.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
translations.ylt: lo, I Paul do say to you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing;
translations.web: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

translations.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
translations.ylt: and I testify again to every man circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law;
translations.web: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

translations.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
translations.ylt: ye were freed from the Christ, ye who in law are declared righteous; from the grace ye fell away;
translations.web: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

translations.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
translations.ylt: for we by the Spirit, by faith, a hope of righteousness do wait for,
translations.web: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

translations.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
translations.ylt: for in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith through love working.
translations.web: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

translations.kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
translations.ylt: Ye were running well; who did hinder you--not to obey the truth?
translations.web: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

translations.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
translations.ylt: the obedience is not of him who is calling you!
translations.web: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

translations.kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
translations.ylt: a little leaven the whole lump doth leaven;
translations.web: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

translations.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
translations.ylt: I have confidence in regard to you in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded; and he who is troubling you shall bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
translations.web: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

translations.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
translations.ylt: And I, brethren, if uncircumcision I yet preach, why yet am I persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away;
translations.web: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

translations.kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
translations.ylt: O that even they would cut themselves off who are unsettling you!
translations.web: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

translations.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
translations.ylt: For ye--to freedom ye were called, brethren, only not the freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through the love serve ye one another,
translations.web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

translations.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
translations.ylt: for all the law in one word is fulfilled--in this: `Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself;'
translations.web: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

translations.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
translations.ylt: and if one another ye do bite and devour, see--that ye may not by one another be consumed.
translations.web: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

translations.kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
translations.ylt: And I say: In the Spirit walk ye, and the desire of the flesh ye may not complete;
translations.web: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

translations.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
translations.ylt: for the flesh doth desire contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit contrary to the flesh, and these are opposed one to another, that the things that ye may will--these ye may not do;
translations.web: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

translations.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
translations.ylt: and if by the Spirit ye are led, ye are not under law.
translations.web: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

translations.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
translations.ylt: And manifest also are the works of the flesh, which are: Adultery, whoredom, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
translations.web: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

translations.kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
translations.ylt: idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, strifes, emulations, wraths, rivalries, dissensions, sects,
translations.web: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

translations.kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: envyings, murders, drunkennesses, revellings, and such like, of which I tell you before, as I also said before, that those doing such things the reign of God shall not inherit.
translations.web: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

translations.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
translations.ylt: And the fruit of the Spirit is: Love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, faith,
translations.web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

translations.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
translations.ylt: meekness, temperance: against such there is no law;
translations.web: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

translations.kjv: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
translations.ylt: and those who are Christ's, the flesh did crucify with the affections, and the desires;
translations.web: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

translations.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
translations.ylt: if we may live in the Spirit, in the Spirit also we may walk;
translations.web: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

translations.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
translations.ylt: let us not become vain-glorious--one another provoking, one another envying!
translations.web: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

translations.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
translations.ylt: Brethren, if a man also may be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of meekness, considering thyself--lest thou also may be tempted;
translations.web: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

translations.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
translations.ylt: of one another the burdens bear ye, and so fill up the law of the Christ,
translations.web: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

translations.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
translations.ylt: for if any one doth think himself to be something--being nothing--himself he doth deceive;
translations.web: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

translations.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
translations.ylt: and his own work let each one prove, and then in regard to himself alone the glorying he shall have, and not in regard to the other,
translations.web: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

translations.kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.
translations.ylt: for each one his own burden shall bear.
translations.web: For each man will bear his own burden.

translations.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
translations.ylt: And let him who is instructed in the word share with him who is instructing--in all good things.
translations.web: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

translations.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
translations.ylt: Be not led astray; God is not mocked; for what a man may sow--that also he shall reap,
translations.web: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

translations.kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
translations.ylt: because he who is sowing to his own flesh, of the flesh shall reap corruption; and he who is sowing to the Spirit, of the Spirit shall reap life age-during;
translations.web: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

translations.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
translations.ylt: and in the doing good we may not be faint-hearted, for at the proper time we shall reap--not desponding;
translations.web: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

translations.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
translations.ylt: therefore, then, as we have opportunity, may we work the good to all, and especially unto those of the household of the faith.
translations.web: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

translations.kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
translations.ylt: Ye see in how large letters I have written to you with my own hand;
translations.web: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

translations.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
translations.ylt: as many as are willing to make a good appearance in the flesh, these constrain you to be circumcised--only that for the cross of the Christ they may not be persecuted,
translations.web: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

translations.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
translations.ylt: for neither do those circumcised themselves keep the law, but they wish you to be circumcised, that in your flesh they may glory.
translations.web: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

translations.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
translations.ylt: And for me, let it not be--to glory, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which to me the world hath been crucified, and I to the world;
translations.web: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

translations.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
translations.ylt: for in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation;
translations.web: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

translations.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
translations.ylt: and as many as by this rule do walk--peace upon them, and kindness, and on the Israel of God!
translations.web: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

translations.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
translations.ylt: Henceforth, let no one give me trouble, for I the scars of the Lord Jesus in my body do bear.
translations.web: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

translations.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Unto the Galatians written from Rome.
translations.ylt: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with your spirit, brethren! Amen.
translations.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
